sv.title: Ariana Grande har noll komisk tajmning i dammiga ”Meet the parents 4”
sv.summary: Krocken mellan Robert De Niros stenhårda svärfar och Ben Stillers mjukisman var en gång receptet på humorguld. Men i den fjärde, plågsamt oinspirerade återträffen har skämten surnat. Inte ens en desperat inkallad Ariana Grande lyckas blåsa liv i den komiska reliken, skriver Helena Lindblad.

en.title: Ariana Grande has zero comic timing in dusty "Meet the Parents 4"
en.summary: The clash between Robert De Niro's stern father-in-law and Ben Stiller's soft-hearted everyman was once the recipe for comedy gold. But in the fourth, painfully uninspired reunion, the jokes have gone sour. Not even a desperately summoned Ariana Grande manages to breathe life into the comedic relic, writes Helena Lindblad.
